title: Coconut {p} with Roasted {v}
steps: Press the {p} and cut it into thick strips. Dust with cornstarch, press into unsweetened shredded coconut, and pan-fry in oil over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes a side, until golden.
Whisk the {sauce} with lime juice, a little maple syrup and chili flakes.
Toss the {v} with the {spice} and half the dressing, top with the tofu, drizzle with the rest, and serve with the {s}.
tip: Roast the eggplant with only a spoonful of oil and let the lime do the work.
